text:
emily: FYI i kicked off an onboarding long-prefill for `vernal-22b-int4x` with 24k context on staging. hitting a reproducible divergence and short token-repeat exactly during the 12288->16384 window when the kvcache grows. filing here before opening an MR.

piotr: can you paste minimal repro + a tiny log snippet? :eyes:

emily: minimal repro: `python tests/long_prefill_runner.py --model vernal-22b-int4x --prefill 18000 --ctx 24576 --seed 101 --log-level debug`

kevin: log excerpt (trimmed):
```
[2026-07-15T18:20:00Z] prefill.start id=pf-4f9b tokens=18000 model=vernal-22b-int4x
[2026-07-15T18:20:12Z] kvcache.reserve shard=0 window=12288->16384 pages=1 page_size=4096 page_hash=5c8a1e
[2026-07-15T18:20:12Z] rope.phase_shift window=12288 delta=0.00087
[2026-07-15T18:20:13Z] decode.token 12290 tok=and prob=0.041
[2026-07-15T18:20:14Z] decode.token 12305 tok=and prob=0.0009  <-- prob collapse + short repeat
[2026-07-15T18:20:14Z] kvcache.handshake prefill_id=pf-4f9b page_hash=5c8a1e ok
```

emily: also saw intermittent `rope.phase_shift_warning` right before the divergence. with rescale off divergence disappears locally.

morgan: sounds similar to the amplification patterns we've seen, but the window here is 12k->16k (not 8k). interesting. is this int4x-specific?

emily: quick matrix runs:
- fp16/rescale=true: clean (10/10)
- int8/rescale=true: tiny jitter (2/10)
- int4x/rescale=true: consistent divergence (8/10)
- int4x/rescale=false: clean (10/10)

piotr: any kernel notes for int4x? pack stride or new memcpy path?

kevin: int4x uses a new interleaved pack that aligns to 512-byte pages for SIMD; QLAB ticket Q-844 mentions boundary sensitivity when a rescale modifies indices near page flips.

prefill-bot: scheduled prefill-sweep job=staging-pp-9012 for vernal-22b-int4x matrix=[fp16,int8,int4x] runs=8 flags=[KV_LOG_EXTRA=1,ROPE_PHASE_DEBUG=1,KVCACHE_PAGE_HASH_VERBOSE=1] requested_by=emily

piotr: hypotheses: (A) rescale applies a small phase shift while kvcache page commit is racing, exposing partial page data to the decoder; (B) int4x dequant rounding amplifies tiny phase deltas into token-prob collapses at large indices; (C) page_hash merge semantics mark a page as "merged" before reordering completes causing transient replays.

morgan: can you try smaller page_size (2048) or set `--kvcache-sync-commit=true` as a quick A/B? also toggle `--enable_rope_phase_shift=false`.

emily: quick local A/B:
- page_size=2048 -> failure rate falls (from 8/10 to 2/10)
- kvcache_sync_commit=true -> failure drops to 1/10
- enable_rope_phase_shift=false -> failure 0/10
so rescale/phase-shift seems central, but page commit ordering affects frequency.

kevin: please attach a token-diff CSV for 12270-12320 (rescale on vs off). spectral diff will help us determine whether tokens truly reorder or decoder score changes cause different sampling.

emily: attaching diffs in the MR i'll open. also uploading the minimal trace and the reproduce script to CI.

ci-bot: job 9012 queued. artifacts will appear at https://ci.internal/reports/9012/longprefill.log

piotr: next actions i suggest:
1) emily to upload token diffs and failing trace to a new MR; include reproduce script.
2) kevin to run microbench of int4x pack/unpack at page-aligned offsets and report ordering guarantees.
3) ops to run the staged sweep (prefill-bot already queued) and include KV_PAGE_SEQ telemetry (so we can see ordering).
4) if rescale confirmed as root cause, we should gate rope_phase_shift behind a conservative guard for quant onboards (flag + checklist item).

morgan: agree. if fix requires refactor to make rescale idempotent w.r.t. in-flight commits, plan for a short-term gate and longer-term patch to kvcache commit/merge to include monotonic sequence numbers.

emily: opening MR now: will include token-diff CSV and smoke-run table (fp16/int8/int4x). tagging @piotr @kevin @morgan.

kevin: one more ask: if anyone reproduces locally, try adding env `INT4X_UNPACK_SAFE=1` (a runtime guard) to see if unpack ordering changes behavior. it helped one local run.

prefill-bot: note: onboarding checklist item suggestion: "quant long-prefill smoke at boundaries 8k/12k/16k/32k with rescale toggled".

emily: adding that to the MR checklist. thanks team. will follow up with MR link and CI artifacts. :thumbsup:
